submitted.rationale: Index 13 (Co 0.35, near CoV2O6) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 1.16e-6 A. Index 3 (Co 0.20) gave 5.1e-7 A and index 11 (Co 0.48) gave 8e-8 A, so photocurrent peaks around the CoV2O6 composition. MEGNet predicts CoV2O6 has a 2.33 eV gap, which absorbs the 3.22 eV illumination.

rejected.reason: Measured 5.1e-7 A, about half of index 13 (V-rich side).
Measured 8e-8 A: photocurrent falls sharply near Co2V2O7.
Not measured. It is Co-rich, so Co3O4-like phases would dominate, and photocurrent was already falling as Co increased.

consultations.verdict: Support (weak): CoV2O6 predicted HSE gap 2.33 eV, below the 3.22 eV photon energy, so it should absorb. Index 13 (Co 0.35) is close to the CoV2O6 composition. Co3V2O8 (2.43 eV) and V2O5 (2.83 eV) also absorb, so the gaps alone do not pick a composition. I am using the first measurement to probe the mixed-phase middle of the line.

Support (weak): CoV5O12 (Co about 0.17) has a predicted gap of 2.61 eV, so it absorbs at 3.22 eV and is a plausible V-rich absorber. Index 3 (Co 0.20) probes the V-rich side, which contrasts with the Co 0.35 result.

Support: Co2V2O7 (Co 0.5) has a predicted gap of 2.59 eV, so it absorbs at 3.22 eV. The measured photocurrent rose from Co 0.20 to Co 0.35, so index 11 (Co 0.48, near Co2V2O7) follows that upward trend.
